title: Capture evidence writing
responsibility: Writes a requested evidence file and appends its metadata to the capture index.

inputs.name: evidenceRequested.env
inputs.description: Environment to check, default process.env; HARNESS_EVIDENCE_DIR must be nonempty and TAKE_SCREENSHOT exactly 1.

inputs.name: recordCapture.line
inputs.description: Capture metadata whose file names the output under the evidence directory.

inputs.name: recordCapture.bytes
inputs.description: Raw bytes or text to write as the capture.

inputs.name: recordCapture.env
inputs.description: Optional environment supplying the evidence directory and opt-in flag.

outputs.name: evidenceRequested
outputs.description: True only when both evidence directory and screenshot flag request evidence.

outputs.name: recordCapture
outputs.description: False with no writes when evidence is not requested; otherwise creates the evidence directory, writes the file, appends its JSON index line and returns true.
